question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Requirement
solution:
The correct answer is **"Essential."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Requirement" **means something that you need or that you must do or have. (अपेक्षा, ज़रूरत, माँग)

 
 
• **Example**: *What are the **requirements**__ for this job?*
 
 
 
• **"Essential"** means something that is necessary or indispensable. (परमावश्‍यक; सर्वथा अपेक्षित)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Good communication skills are **essential**__ for this job.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of **"Requirement"** is **"Essential."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Serious** means something that is important or grave in nature. (दुर्दशाग्रस्‍त; बुरी हालत या ख़तरनाक या चिंताजनक)
 
• **Vague** means something that is unclear or imprecise. (अस्‍पष्‍ट या अनिश्‍चित)
 
• **Importance** means the quality of being significant or valuable. (महत्व)
